notes: Every studio run of boss-hero-assets, picked or rejected (design rule 5). The SDXL-CN jobs ran a byte-identical staged copy of art/workflows/sprites/boss-hero-sdxl-cn.json (sha256 cff8b70f…) from the main checkout ignored .build/ folder, because the studio reads workflows from the main checkout and the worktree branch is not merged. Inputs: frigate-clay-key.png = boss_sheet clayhint + keyin #00FF00 of the rig hero view; frigate-depth.png = the rig depth (hints drawn in); today-frigate-key.png = boss_sheet atlasframe frigate on #00FF00.
